observations: Photo 0: Top view of a silver laptop with Apple logo on the lid, placed inside an open white box. The box has a circular cutout and a rectangular slot. The laptop appears to be a MacBook, but no model or year is visible.
Photo 1: Bottom view of the same laptop, showing four black rubber feet at the corners. The surface is smooth and silver, with no visible branding or model information.
Photo 2: Side view of the laptop from the bottom, showing the edge and part of the box. The laptop is still in the box, and no ports, labels, or model identifiers are visible.
All photos show the same item from different angles, with no text or labels readable on the device itself.
The seller claims it is a 'MacBook Air M4 2025 15-Inch 16Gb | 256Gb', but no such details are visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: No model, year, or specs visible in any photo. The seller's text is not verifiable from the images.
No photo shows the laptop powered on or in use. No screen, keyboard, or ports are visible to confirm functionality.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 show the laptop inside an open box with foam inserts, consistent with an open-box item.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be a MacBook Air M4 2025, or may have different specs than claimed (e.g., 15-inch, 16GB RAM, 256GB storage).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bottom label or a screenshot of the system report (About This Mac) showing model, year, and specs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Apple laptop, not as a specific high-end model, which could be significantly cheaper.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be functional or may have hidden faults (e.g., screen damage, keyboard issues, battery problems).
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the laptop powered on, displaying the desktop, and keyboard input working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

risks.risk: The item may be a refurbished or non-genuine unit, or may have been tampered with.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number and a verification check via Apple's website (if possible remotely).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified, with lower confidence in authenticity and value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the bottom label showing the model number and serial number.
A video or photo of the laptop powered on, showing the desktop and keyboard working.
A screenshot of 'About This Mac' showing the exact model, year, RAM, and storage.
A photo of the original box with any labels or stickers that might confirm the model.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Apple laptop, but the specific model, year, and specs claimed by the seller cannot be verified from the photos. Functionality is also unverified. Without proof of the claimed model and working condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant risk.
